derivation.behavior: Mutable rows use explicit revision-based compare-and-set.
derivation.canonical_behavior: Every authoritative mutable aggregate carries Revision; stale expected revisions change zero rows and return ErrStaleWrite without implicit retry.

invariants: The first valid writer increments revision exactly once.
A stale expected revision changes zero rows and returns ErrStaleWrite.
Exactly one concurrent writer using the same expected revision succeeds.
Repository code does not automatically re-read and retry a stale mutation.
